A '''rapid cargo evacuation shute''' was a feature on vehicles allowing its users to rapidly dump their payloads. It was often used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to avoid being caught, it could mean the difference between [[Prison/Legends|jail]] time and slipping past the authorities another day. No corporation officially claimed to build products with this functionality.<ref name="Fly" />
